# Comet Code of Conduct

English · [中文](CODE_OF_CONDUCT-zh.md)

This code applies to Comet issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project-managed spaces. It also applies when someone represents the Comet project at an event.

## Community expectations

- Respect participants of different backgrounds, languages, and levels of experience. Give new contributors room to ask questions and learn.
- Discuss code, designs, and documentation using facts and evidence others can check. When you disagree, explain the issue you see and its impact.
- Respect privacy. Obtain any necessary consent and remove personal information and credentials before sharing logs, screenshots, or conversations.
- Harassment, discrimination, insults, threats, sharing private information without consent, and retaliation against people who report concerns or assist a review are prohibited.

## Reporting and enforcement

Use **Report content** in the menu for the relevant GitHub content. Choose **Report to repository admins** when it is available. If the option is unavailable or the report involves an administrator, [report it to GitHub Support](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam). Include relevant links and context. Share sensitive details only through the reporting channel.

Maintainers limit disclosure of reports to the people needed to handle them. Depending on severity, impact, and whether behavior recurs, they may request a correction, remove content, restrict participation, or ban an account.
